one_line: The paper develops and validates an ISO 50001 energy-management-system sustainability index, applied via questionnaires/interviews to 31 ISO 50001-certified companies of mixed industry types in Thailand; continuous-process sectors (cement, pulp & paper, iron & steel, sugar) appear only as literature-review examples.
